source.title: Commentary Critical and Explanatory on the Whole Bible
source.author: Robert Jamieson, A. R. Fausset and David Brown
source.edition: CCEL expanded electronic edition of the 1871 public-domain text

entries.heading: Verse 1
entries.text: Mt 26:1-16 . Christ's Final Announcement of his Death, as Now within Two Days, and the Simultaneous Conspiracy of the Jewish Authorities to Compass It--The Anointing at Bethany--Judas Agrees with the Chief Priests to Betray His Lord. ( = Mr 14:1-11; Lu 22:1-6; Joh 12:1-11 ).

entries.heading: Verse 17
entries.text: Mt 26:17-30 . Preparation for and Last Celebration of the Passover Announcement of the Traitor, and Institution of the Supper. ( = Mr 14:12-26; Lu 22:7-23; Joh 13:1-3, 10, 11, 18-30 ).

entries.heading: Verse 31
entries.text: Mt 26:31-35 . The Desertion of Jesus by His Disciples, and the Denial of Peter Foretold. ( = Mr 14:27-31; Lu 22:31-38; Joh 13:36-38 ).

entries.heading: Verse 36
entries.text: Mt 26:36-46 . The Agony in the Garden. ( = Mr 14:32-42; Lu 22:39-46 ).

entries.heading: Verse 47
entries.text: Mt 26:47-56 . Betrayal and Apprehension of Jesus--Flight of His Disciples. ( = Mr 14:43-52; Lu 22:47-54; Joh 18:1-12 ).

entries.heading: Verse 57
entries.text: Mt 26:57-75 . Jesus Arraigned before the Sanhedrim Condemned to Die, and Shamefully Entreated--The Denial of Peter. ( = Mr 14:53-72; Lu 22:54-71; Joh 18:13-18, 24-27 ).
